title: NeuroBridge: Using Generative AI to Bridge Cross-neurotype Communication Differences through Neurotypical Perspective-taking

bias_targets.methodology: A user study involving 12 neurotypical participants who interacted with an LLM-simulated autistic persona, followed by surveys and semi-structured interviews to evaluate how the simulation shaped their perceptions of autism and whether the AI's portrayal reinforced stereotypes about autistic individuals' cognitive and communication abilities.
